title: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf from Innistrad who leads her friends in search of the Moonsilver Key, drawing on her old faith in the Church.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker who burns a path through the undead at Thraben.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who finds the clue to the Betzolds and quickly kills the ghosts in the Betzold mansion.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who slows the undead with time magic and speaks with Sorin Markov.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar commander who leads her cathars against the undead and joins the search.

entities.name: Worrin Betzold
entities.description: A strict old bishop of the Thraben cathedral whom Arlinn knew, now an undead zombie preaching to other zombies; she puts him to rest.

entities.name: Dennick Betzold
entities.description: Worrin's son, a ghost in the Betzold mansion who tells the group that the key was given to a vampire of the Markovs.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire prince and planeswalker who holds the Moonsilver Key at Markov manor and refuses to hand it over.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel summoned by Arlinn's faith who fights Sorin so the others can fetch the key.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel Sorin created, who can no longer hear prayers; her headless statue holds the key.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Arlinn's old mentor who taught her to give in to her instincts and wants to tear out Innistrad's heart.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker who once raised the zombies to fight the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A cathar who showed the others that even the dead fear fire.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: The witch of the Dawnhart Coven whom a woodcut in Kaya's tome resembles.

entities.name: Betzold family
entities.description: A family from Gavony who were handed a box by a witch, in a woodcut, and whose ancestor gave the key to a vampire.

entities.name: Markov family
entities.description: The vampire house of Sorin Markov, whose manor now lies in ruins.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key needed for the Harvesttide ritual, held by Sorin and found in his chambers.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The ruined cathedral of Thraben, now overrun by the unhallowed dead.

entities.name: Betzold mansion
entities.description: The haunted, dilapidated mansion in Gavony where Dennick's ghost lingers.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: The region of Innistrad where the Betzold family lived.

entities.name: Markov manor
entities.description: Sorin's crumbling castle, reached by a broken bridge, where he sits in the throne room.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the nights are growing longer.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The catastrophe that broke Innistrad, warped holy places and swelled the ranks of the undead.

entities.name: Harvesttide
entities.description: The festival ritual that needs the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The monstrous invaders against whom the zombies were once raised.

events.summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
events.quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

events.summary: Kaya's research turns up a book showing the Betzolds being handed a box by a witch, and Arlinn recognizes Worrin Betzold's name as an old bishop.
events.quote: The caption labeled them the Betzolds, from Gavony.

events.summary: Adeline spots Worrin preaching to a congregation of zombies in the nave, and Arlinn confirms it is him.
events.quote: To Arlinn's horror, he seems to be preaching to a gathered crowd.

events.summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
events.quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

events.summary: Arlinn questions the undead Worrin about the key, but he only answers with Dennick's name, and she puts him to rest.
events.quote: Arlinn gives Worrin the only rest she can

events.summary: In Gavony an old woman tells the group that Dennick, Worrin's son, holed up in the old family mansion.
events.quote: "He holed up in the old family mansion.

events.summary: Kaya enters the haunted Betzold mansion alone and dispatches the ghosts at speed.
events.quote: Kaya's putting them down at an incredible rate.

events.summary: Adeline breaks down the upstairs door and Kaya presents the ghost of Dennick Betzold.
Arlinn tells Dennick his father is dead and asks about the key; he says his great-grandfather gave it to a vampire of the Markovs for safekeeping.
events.quote: My great-grandfather gave it over to one of the vampires for safekeeping.

events.summary: Dennick names Sorin Markov as the prince who took the key, and Arlinn stays behind to listen to him.
Outside Markov manor Arlinn repairs a broken Avacynian symbol and begins a prayer, and her friends join in one by one.
events.quote: she rights the symbol and starts a prayer.

events.summary: The group crosses the broken bridge into Markov manor and makes its way toward the throne room.
Arlinn forces open the throne room doors and finds Sorin Markov reading on his broken throne.
events.quote: Sorin Markov sits with one leg slung over the broken throne of his house.

events.summary: Sorin refuses to give up the key, saying he has sacrificed enough and his family may descend into eternal night.
Arlinn brings up Avacyn and Sorin slashes her arm with his sword, forbidding her to speak of her.
events.quote: She's not through the name before the sword's swinging through the air.

events.summary: Sigarda arrives in golden light and blocks Sorin's blow with her heron-headed scythe.
events.quote: A feather falls between them, gold and glowing

events.summary: Sigarda tells Arlinn the key is in Sorin's chambers on the third floor and fights Sorin so the others can go.
events.quote: You will find the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's personal chambers on the third floor.

events.summary: Teferi finds the Moonsilver Key in the hands of a headless statue of Avacyn, and Arlinn takes it.

relations.note: He was a strict instructor in theology at the cathedral.
relations.quote: Worrin in life was as strict an instructor as they came.

relations.note: He taught her to give in to her instincts.
relations.quote: Give in to your passions and your instincts
"Have you already forgotten why you made her?" she says.

relations.note: They fight in the throne room.
relations.quote: "Go !" cries the angel, Sorin's sword slicing at her armor.

relations.note: She raised the zombies who now fill the cathedral.
relations.quote: Once, Liliana had raised all these zombies to fight against the Eldrazi.

relations.note: They fight side by side in the vanguard and rear.
relations.quote: "All right. I'll be the vanguard, and you take the rear, Chandra Nalaar," she says.
it is your faith that summoned me here.
